items.t: Fuel gauge bounces or reads wrong
items.note: Price assumes the tank or pump module must come out to reach the sender.

items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator - do not drive if unrepaired
items.job: Replace passenger airbag inflator or module
items.note: Free under the Takata recall, and dealers can arrange a tow. Check the VIN now.

items.t: Radiator leaks coolant into the transmission
items.job: Replace radiator and flush transmission fluid
items.note: If the transmission is already damaged, a rebuild or replacement costs much more. Many add a separate trans cooler.

items.t: Timing chain whine from worn guides
items.job: Replace timing chain guides and tensioners
items.note: Many shops replace the water pump at the same time. Cost rises a lot if the chain jumps and damages the engine.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong
items.note: Some 2006 and 2008 trucks got a new sender free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Engine relay can cause stalling or no-start (recall)
items.job: Replace ECM relay in the power distribution module
items.note: High end is a full power distribution module. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Front crash sensor can rust (recall)
items.note: Free under recall or a warranty extension. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Weak welds on rear lower control link (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: CVT judder, hesitation and power loss
items.note: A software update or fluid change fixes some mild cases. Ask a dealer about any remaining CVT coverage.

items.t: CVT cooler hose can come off (recall)
items.job: Install CVT oil cooler hose repair kit
items.note: Free under recall; check the VIN. If the CVT was damaged by low fluid, repair costs much more.

items.t: CVT problems covered by extended warranty
items.note: Ask a Nissan dealer if extended CVT coverage still applies to your VIN. Some cases need only a software update.

items.t: Transfer case seal leak on AWD models
items.note: If the case is damaged it must be replaced, which costs much more. Nissan has sometimes shared the cost; ask.

items.t: Hood secondary latch may not hold (recall)
items.job: Adjust hood release cable and latch
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Brake lights stay on or misbehave (recall)
items.job: Inspect brake light switch and replace relay
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Front brake torque members may crack (recall)
items.note: Price is for both sides. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: ABS software can lengthen stops on rough roads (recall)
items.note: Software fix done free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag may turn off with an adult seated (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger occupant sensor control unit
items.note: Some trucks only need a software update. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Hood secondary latch welds may fail (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Third-row headrests may not lock (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Driver power seat may not be secured (recall)
items.job: Install and tighten driver seat fasteners
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Driver lap belt pretensioner may be missing a rivet (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Front brake calipers may break (recall)
items.note: Includes bleeding the brakes. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.
